name: AI2D: Allen Institute for AI Diagram Dataset
description: AI2D (Allen Institute for AI Diagrams) is a rich dataset of 4,900+ grade-school science diagrams accompanied by over 15,000 multiple-choice questions. Developed by the Allen Institute for AI, the dataset features dense parse annotations linking diagram graphical elements, arrows, text labels, and semantic relations to test multimodal diagram understanding and visual reasoning.
